user.title: SST Local (MCS350)
user.description: Thermostat must be reachable from Home Assistant over TCP (port 6350).

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Writes the auto mode schedule (4 points per day) for the selected days.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days the schedule is written to.

points.name: Points
points.description: Exactly 4 points: list of {time: "HH:MM", temperature: 0-45}. Each temperature applies from its time until the next point.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns the current auto mode schedule of the thermostat.
